_comment: Recipes for the generic crafting stations (world/crafting_manager.py). Generated by tools/build_crafting_professions.py. Guaranteed success; skill only gates access. 'count' = units produced per craft. 'station' = must stand at a sawmill. Gear 'output' specs feed LootGenerator like data/blacksmithing/recipes.json.

woodcutting._staging_note: staged_post_60 marks a recipe whose input material is authored, has art, and is deliberately NOT gatherable yet. Kyle, 2026-10-31: 'the last 20-25 items in leather, cloth, ore, wood are all POST-60 game... try to keep it 15 or less gatherables up until lvl 60.' Woodcutting's ladder is 40 woods; the first 15 are live (skill 0-170) and the remaining 25 go live when 60+ zones exist to hold them. validate_content skips these rather than reporting them as broken, because 'not built yet' and 'broken' look identical to a checker that only asks whether the input can be obtained today.
